puzzleText: The informant tells you that the illuminaughty are planning a heist. He gives you a list of number plates: RKT94J ZPQ20M MTL75K BVC68L XNW03S PYL81D One of these might be the number plate of their getaway car. You send an email with the list to an undercover spy inside the illuminaughty. "Which one of these is the real number plate?" you ask. But he doesn't give you the answer. Instead, he replies: ------------------------------- "I can't tell you the real number plate. Because they are watching our emails. Here - take your list back: BKT94J ZRQ20M MTT75K BVC38L XNW07S PYL81V Sorry I can't help you." ------------------------------- At first you feel frustrated. But then you take a second look. Yippee! You realise that he did tell you the real number plate. What is the real number plate?
hint: Compare the 2 lists. Look at the changes the undercover agent made. The changes are correct.
title: Naughty Number Plate Shuffle
